name: arm
description: A/B test arm the subscriber was assigned to: control or variant

name: converted
description: Whether the subscriber converted to a paid plan during the experiment; stored as a flag, read as levels 0 and 1

name: plan
description: Subscription plan tier: basic, plus or pro

name: churned
description: Whether the subscriber cancelled within a year of signup; stored as a flag, read as levels 0 and 1

name: late_payment
description: Count-style indicator: 1 when the subscriber has paid at least one invoice late, else 0

name: defaulted
description: Credit outcome flag: whether the subscriber's account went into default

name: signup_date
description: Calendar day the subscriber signed up

name: first_repeat_order
description: Calendar day of the subscriber's first repeat order after signup

name: revenue
description: Lifetime revenue in USD with exact cents

name: cost
description: Lifetime cost to serve in USD with exact cents
